context: Start by inventorying documented passthrough use and the existing test that deliberately passes TODO_DB_AUTH_TOKEN. Prefer an exact always-denied set containing TODO_DB_AUTH_TOKEN, TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN, TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN, and TURSO_API_TOKEN unless a demonstrated verification use case requires a separate explicit dangerous override. Never infer sensitivity from arbitrary wildcard names. Emit only denied variable names, never values. Update README security language and tests for local and hosted verify paths. Record a stop decision instead of changing compatibility if the explicit passthrough contract is intentionally authoritative and the threat model accepts it.
description: Close the credential-specific gap in verify --run environment sanitization. The default allowlist is safe, but TODO_DB_VERIFY_ENV_PASSTHROUGH currently permits TODO_DB_AUTH_TOKEN and TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN, handing the hosted database's bearer credential to a command stored by database writers. Make an explicit compatibility decision between an unconditional exact denylist for todo-db/Turso control-plane credentials and a separately named, high-friction dangerous override; do not use a broad *TOKEN*/*SECRET* wildcard because legitimate opted-in verification credentials exist. This item is independent of wrapper/resolver rollout and must preserve the hosted verify-run opt-in gate.

anti_patterns.instead: deny the exact tracker and Turso control-plane credentials or require a separate dangerous override
anti_patterns.why: explicitly opted-in verification commands may legitimately require unrelated API credentials and names are not a reliable sensitivity type system

anti_patterns.dont: Print denied secret values in warnings or test evidence
anti_patterns.why: the mitigation would itself leak bearer credentials

preserves.behavior: Default verification subprocess environment remains minimal and hosted verify --run still requires TODO_DB_ALLOW_HOSTED_VERIFY_RUN=1.
